structured.answer: I'd open an account at פסגות and buy the ילין לפידות מחקה S&P 500 (4D) fund (5139282). The page says that leaves about 86,492 ₪ after 10 years, but that's with its example of 10,000 now plus 500 a month, not my 30,000.

stuck.why: The example is 10,000 today and 500 a month, but I have 30,000. I couldn't change it, so the 86,492 isn't really my number.

stuck.where: Fund list, minus amounts next to funds (screens 2-4)
stuck.why: I wasn't sure if -447, -1,268 etc. mean I'd get that much less than with my pick, or that the fund loses money.
'-0.05% לעומת הבחירה שלכם' and 86,449 is almost the same as 86,492. I didn't know if it mattered.
